tagline: Whisk AI Labs is an AI visual creation tool for creators, marketers, and product teams
description: Whisk AI Labs is an AI visual creation tool for creators, marketers, and product teams. Start with a short idea, upload reference images when needed, choose a style or format, and generate Whisk-style images, short video concepts, or polished prompts. It is built for fast visual exploration, product mockups, social content, character ideas, ad creatives, and image remix workflows.
